WatchHomePromo.title: Humpito ngal wonaa sapii. Laawol nde yimɓe ndiyata mo soppi.
WatchHomePromo.description: Min woodani rewɓe e kuutal ndee e juulde video maa, njoɓdi makko e ngol nguu no, hokkude feccere translation ɗiɗi e platformaji ɗi yimɓe ngoodi ɗoo, ndiyan, yiya, kadi humpita.
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryTitle: Njojji kiitaaba video ɓuri translate ko e duniyaru
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryDescription: Feccere translation ɗiɗi, ɓangiiɗe e njiɗɓe ministry keewii, waɗii njojji e taalalii language tracks ɗi ɓuri ɗuuɗi ngam yimɓe heɓde haala Isa e ɗemngal haa soklaaɓe.
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesTitle: Naatnude hoyreɗɗe ceertuɗe e formiiɗe hesi
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesDescription: Min rewrtii no haaliiɗe injiiil ngoodi e nataal, ɗum haɗii translations tiiɗɗi e formiiɗe sahaaɗi ngam humpito waawi yaltude e laawol e platformaji, culture, e screeni.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamTitle: No ɓurti njojji tan. Ko ekkitaare mission.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamDescription: Jesus Film Project ko group worldwide e translatori, media specialisti, editori, e creatori ɓanngiiɗi feccere ministry e tooɗeji ngam disciple-makers fuu.
WatchHomePromo.nextStepsDescription: Hollu watchere e peluang konkret e njiyla spiritual, walla ndiɗi ɓeydude laawol ko community, Scripture, walla mission.
WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryDescription: Njojji media Kiristaani mawɗo e videeji, films, e resources ɗuuɗi keɓetee e ɗemɗe ko ɗuuɗi ngam ministry e evangelism e duniyaru.
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsDescription: Management video, distribution content, audience engagement, e analytics waɗi ngam wallude ministries heɓde yimɓe ɓeyde e moƴƴere.
WatchHomePromo.invitationTitle: Wallu waññeede <highlight>generation fuɗɗiɗo</highlight> e tooli mission
WatchHomePromo.invitationDescription: Min noddi kuutortoɓe, creatori, e njiɗɓe e access njangeere. Ƴeewto tooli hesi ɗow, hokku feedback, kadi wallu njoɓdi kuutorgol mission ɗow.
